title: Take away their most efficient high-volume actions
supporting_stats: Offensive Rebound: 77.1% on 35 attempts; Cut: 60.9% on 110 attempts
recommendation: Each is 5+ points above their 40.5% overall clip on 15+ attempts. Offensive Rebound: hit a body on every shot before going to the ball. Cut: jump to the ball on every pass and see man and ball -- no back-cuts behind ball-watchers.

title: Funnel them into their worst high-volume looks
supporting_stats: ISO: 33.8% on 77 attempts; Hand Off: 34.5% on 84 attempts
recommendation: Each is 5+ points below their 40.5% overall clip -- don't help off these actions; make them keep taking them.

title: Pressure the actions they turn it over on
supporting_stats: Transition: 43 TO in 244 uses (17.6% vs 11.8% across all actions); Post-Up: 28 TO in 162 uses (17.3% vs 11.8% across all actions)
recommendation: Loosest actions per use, not the most common ones -- load ball pressure and gap help onto these specifically rather than pressing everything.
